facts.text: Jaime, you eat, then you save the world. In that order.
facts.why: Invented line signed Nana. Wikiquote has a real food line from Milagro: 'You went in to get us jobs, and all you brought back was a hamburger?'
facts.fix: You went in to get us jobs, and all you brought back was a hamburger?

fix_note.text: You went in to get us jobs, and all you brought back was a hamburger?

vibe.verdict: A warm family kitchen that suits the film's heart and Mexican American food, but the best props (the Big Belly Burger box, the Bugship) are missing.
missing: The scarab hidden in a Big Belly Burger box (Jenny hands it to Jaime)
Dr Sanchez: 'My name is not Sanchez' (Kord Tower)
The eviction news at the Reyes house (the opening)
Ted Kord's Bugship and its weapons (the island rescue)
ideas: Swap the Nana note for Milagro's hamburger line.
Swap 'Pan dulce sweet buns' for 'Big Belly Burger, scarab not included'.
Swap the horchata name for 'Host acquired horchata'.
Swap the 'Queso fundido' note for 'Uncle Rudy's Bugship nachos, tested in the garage'.
